exposure: Gestational age: 28 to <34 weeks (very preterm), 34 to <37 weeks (late preterm), and 37 to <41 weeks (term)
cohort: 105 appropriate-for-gestational-age (AGA) infants born at ≥28 weeks' gestation
finding: Cord blood leptin levels in the third trimester were independently associated with birth weight and birth length after adjusting for gestational age, delivery mode, multiple pregnancy, pregnancy-induced hypertension, gestational diabetes mellitus, infant's BMI, and cord blood IGF-1 levels.
